data.name: JordanSec
data.description:
During a recent nationwide cyber event in Jordan, students from schools and universities competed for a limited number of seats in the final round.
Fifteen teams made it through.
Among them, one team name is not what it first appears to be. It is neither random nor purely technical. Its meaning becomes clear only after connecting it to a recognizable figure outside the competition itself.
Your mission is to trace the public trail of the event, locate the finalists, isolate the unusual team name, and identify the person it points to.
Once found, then you must find the website.
Submit your answer in the following format:

first part is the name and the 2nd part is hidden somewhere 
Format: KaliTeam{Name_2nd-part}

data.name: Dead Air
data.description:
Author: S1l3nt

Two damaged records were recovered from an abandoned airport operations desk. The passenger document no longer identifies its carrier, flight number, or destination. The accompanying operations log is incomplete, and its final station and runway values were deliberately removed. Reconstruct the movement using the remaining visual evidence and publicly available aviation sources. Follow the record chronologically. An operational amendment may replace information written earlier in the log, and a runway family or arrival configuration does not necessarily identify the exact runway. Recover the origin, identify the flight and destination, verify the published schedule, and resolve the final operational record against authoritative aeronautical information. Preserve official aviation notation. Flag Format: KaliTeam{ORIGIN_ICAO_FLIGHT_DESTINATION_IATA_DESTINATION_ICAO_DEPARTURE_ARRIVAL_FREQUENCY_EQUIPMENT_DURATION_OBSERVATION_RECIPROCAL_RUNWAY_ACTIVE_RUNWAY_ELEVATION} Formatting Rules: - Use uppercase letters. - Do not include colons in scheduled times. - Use the timetable’s equipment code exactly as published. - Write the flight duration as a number followed by MIN. - Keep the complete observation group in Zulu notation. - Write the elevation as a number followed by FT. - Do not include spaces.

data.name: OSHIT
data.description:
Author: S1l3nt

Asterion Field Services disappeared from public view, but parts of its online infrastructure are still accessible. A recovered invoice is your only starting point. Trace the company’s surviving public footprint and correlate the records connected to project NQ-441. The information is distributed across multiple services, archived documents, and project references. Recover the following: - The full name of the authorized project contact - The company registration number - The internal operations portal identifier - The receiving warehouse code - The industrial area associated with the final delivery Not every useful page is linked directly, and the complete answer cannot be recovered from a single service. Flag Format: KaliTeam{CONTACT_REGISTRATION_PORTAL_WAREHOUSE_AREA} Formatting Rules: - Use uppercase letters. - Replace spaces with underscores. - Preserve numbers and internal codes exactly as written. - Do not add punctuation.
